steps.caption: Six models, one per thing being scored: companies, leads, contacts, requirements, opportunities, relationships.
This is Company attractiveness. The version number shows which rules are live.
Weights add up to 100; if they don't, they are scaled to 100.
Each factor says what it measures — here Company scale: headcount and number of sites.
'If unknown': leave it out (default), count it as half, or count it as zero.
Say growth matters more this quarter: raise Growth indicators from 20 to 30.
Priority thresholds: the lowest score for each band — e.g. 80 and up is Very High.
Industry weights: how attractive each sector is, from 0 to 1. GCCs always count as 1.
Focus cities: where occupancy counts for the location factor — here Pune.
Try on a record before saving — pick Zentrix Analytics.
The preview shows the score under the new weights. Nothing is saved yet.
To keep it: add a note saying why, then 'Save as new version'. Old versions stay, so past scores can be explained.
Versions: switch back to an older one, or switch a model off, any time.
